# UI Forge — Award-Caliber UI Engineering

Follow the 5-phase workflow below in order. Load reference files only when you reach their phase (progressive disclosure). Distilled from 139 award-level designs; every token has proven hex values — never invent palette colors.

## Tech-stack routing (decide first)

- **Default:** React + Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion (component animation) + GSAP ScrollTrigger (scroll-driven) + Lenis (smooth scroll).
- **Fallback:** vanilla HTML/CSS/JS — use `assets/motion-utils.js` (framework-agnostic) + `assets/tokens.css`.
- **React Three Fiber (`ScrollControls`/`useScroll`):** ONLY when the user explicitly asks for true WebGL/3D scenes. Otherwise fake depth with CSS `perspective` + `translateZ` (cheaper, more reliable).

## Phase 1 — Brief extraction

Extract from the request (or infer from the product): **domain** (fintech, AI, food, health, luxury…), **mood** (trust, energy, calm, opulence), **audience** (developers, consumers, enterprise), and **page type** (landing, dashboard, mobile screen). If the domain is ambiguous, pick the closest row in the domain table in `references/theme-derivation.md` — do not stall asking questions.

## Phase 2 — Theme derivation

Load **`references/theme-derivation.md`**. Classify the domain → pick a proven palette bundle (14 bundles with hex) or derive tokens with the 8-step method → choose the type voice + Google Fonts pairing → copy spacing/radius/shadow/motion tokens. Start from **`assets/tokens.css`** and set `[data-theme]` values. Rules that separate award-level from average: ONE accent color; one type family with 400/800 weight contrast; negative letter-spacing on display type; 4px spacing scale; one dominant element per screen; light themes separate with shadows, dark themes with 1px borders + glow.

## Phase 3 — Layout composition

Load **`references/layout-blueprints.md`**. Pick ONE hero archetype (split, centered stack, full-bleed, blob/organic) and follow the universal landing section sequence (navbar → hero → logo cloud → features → showcase → stats → testimonials → pricing → CTA → footer), or the dashboard shell, or the mobile screen skeleton. Copy the ASCII wireframe + Tailwind skeleton, then substitute your theme tokens.

## Phase 4 — Motion & 3D layer

Load **`references/motion-3d-playbook.md`** (copy-paste recipes). Minimum bar for "premium": smooth scroll (Lenis synced to ScrollTrigger), hero entrance choreography (staggered reveal + clip-path masks), scroll reveals at 15% viewport, and hover micro-interactions on every interactive element. Add 3D (perspective tilt, z-depth parallax, horizontal scroll-jack, camera dolly) per the brief. Reference implementation: **`assets/Hero3D.jsx`**; vanilla helpers: **`assets/motion-utils.js`**.

## Phase 5 — Quality gate (check every item before delivering)

1. **Contrast:** body text ≥ 4.5:1; muted text used only for non-critical labels; white text on accent passes.
2. **Hierarchy:** exactly one dominant element per viewport; H1 uses `--fs-display` with `letter-spacing: -0.03em`.
3. **Spacing rhythm:** all spacing from the 4px scale; sections pad 96–128px desktop / 64px mobile; max content width 1120–1280px.
4. **Token discipline:** all colors/radii/shadows come from tokens — zero hard-coded hex in components.
5. **Performance:** animations touch ONLY `transform` + `opacity`; never width/height/top/left in scroll handlers; `will-change` used sparingly; 3D/canvas layers lazy-mounted (IntersectionObserver) and paused off-screen.
6. **Reduced motion:** every animation recipe includes a `prefers-reduced-motion` fallback — smooth scroll, parallax, marquee, and ambient effects must be disabled under it.
7. **Interaction coverage:** every button/link/card has hover + active + focus-visible states derived from tokens.
8. **Responsive:** verify at 375px and 1440px; horizontal scroll-jacked sections degrade to vertical stacks on mobile.

## Files

| File | Load when |
|---|---|
| `references/theme-derivation.md` | Phase 2 — palettes, type, token scales, domain mapping |
| `references/layout-blueprints.md` | Phase 3 — wireframes + HTML/Tailwind skeletons |
| `references/motion-3d-playbook.md` | Phase 4 — all animation/3D recipes |
| `assets/tokens.css` | Phase 2 — starter token stylesheet, themes via `[data-theme]` |
| `assets/motion-utils.js` | Phase 4 — vanilla JS helpers (magnetic, tilt, reveals, Lenis+GSAP init, cursor glow) |
| `assets/Hero3D.jsx` | Phase 4 — annotated React reference hero with layered 3D parallax |
